title: The pup at twelve, the bed by the door
logline: The bed by the door with the blanket, the pup in it, twelve, and the door open an inch for the cold air he likes. The lamp across the room. The last January page but one.

panels.composition: A dog bed with a wool blanket beside a garage door open an inch onto a dark alley, an old three-legged dog lying in it, a lit lamp across the room.
